main.remarks: Represents the certificate-backed signing material selected by a resolver or store for a concrete signing operation.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create an empty access-key signature signing material value.
constructor.returns: Empty access-key signature signing material value.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create access-key signature signing material from a certificate using the default thumbprint-based `RsaPssSha512` signing configuration.
method.param: Certificate supplying the signing identity and RSA private key.
method.returns: Certificate-backed signing material derived from the supplied certificate.

property.name: Certificate
property.summary: Certificate selected for the signing operation.

property.name: SignatureInfo
property.summary: Signing metadata associated with the selected certificate.

property.name: Thumbprint
property.summary: Normalized certificate thumbprint associated with the signing material.
